verdict.rationale: Plausible ships two documented APIs — the Events API for recording pageviews/custom events and the Stats API (including the /api/v2/query endpoint) for reading historical/real-time stats — so core tracking and querying can be done outside the UI. However, most configuration/management features visible in the UI (funnels, goals, annotations, SSO, shared links, email/Slack reports, site/team management, CSV import/export) have no documented API endpoints, and probes show no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs (llms.txt, docs.md, openapi.json all 404), indicating the API surface is far narrower than the UI. missing for 10: API endpoints for goals/funnels/annotations creation, team/site administration via API, shared-link/report configuration via API, and a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec.
